title: A Lipschitz map whose a.e. derivative agrees a.e. with a continuous map is C¹ (parent step 7)
statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ∈ ℕ, f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ Lipschitz (LipschitzWith L f), Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open and g : ℝⁿ → L(ℝⁿ, ℝᵏ) continuous on Ω, and assume f has Fréchet derivative g(v) at Lⁿ-a.e. v ∈ Ω. Then f is C¹ on Ω (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f Ω); in fact f has derivative g(x) at every x ∈ Ω.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (L : NNReal) (Ω : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid n → (Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k)), 0 < n → LipschitzWith L f → IsOpen Ω → ContinuousOn g Ω → (∀ᵐ v ∂volume, v ∈ Ω → HasFDerivAt f (g v) v) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f Ω
